Example pool: three teams, two days

pool_example.Rd

A tiny pool used in the examples and tests: three teams (Alpha, Bravo, and the Los Angeles Clippers), two players, and two days of games. Alpha beats Bravo on October 20, 2026; the Clippers beat Alpha on October 21, the Clippers' first game. Every team has a 50 percent line.

Usage

pool_example

Format

A list with the inputs of compute_pool():

game_results_raw

One row per team game.

scores

One row per game, with scores.

projections

Win totals.

picks

Two players' picks.

standings

Official standings.

params

A list: yesterday, today, season_start, num_games.

Examples

str(pool_example, max.level = 1)
#> List of 6
#>  $ game_results_raw: tibble [4 × 8] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ scores          : tibble [2 × 8] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ projections     : tibble [3 × 3] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ picks           : tibble [4 × 4] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ standings       : tibble [3 × 3] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ params          :List of 4
